i.norm: Tests for the {@link Tag} class focusing on the {@code TextBoundary} option and case-insensitive tag resolution.

Verifies that tag lookup via {@link Tag#valueOf} and {@link TagSet#valueOf} treats tag names case-insensitively under any default locale, ensuring "script" and "SCRIPT" resolve to the same tag instance.
Static valueOf should consider "script" and "SCRIPT" equal
TagSet.valueOf should return the exact same (interned) instance for both cases

Verifies that the {@link Tag#TextBoundary} option can be set on an arbitrary tag and that setting any option automatically marks the tag as {@link Tag#Known}.

Flow:

  1. A newly constructed custom tag has no options set, so {@code TextBoundary} is absent.
  2. After calling {@link Tag#set(int)} with {@code TextBoundary}, the option is present.
  3. Calling {@code set()} also sets the {@code Known} flag, so {@link Tag#isKnownTag()} returns true.
